patterns.note: Content is consistently centered within a narrow column, surrounded by generous horizontal and vertical whitespace, creating an open and focused presentation.
Large, elegant serif headings are used for all primary section titles, creating a strong visual anchor, contrasting with smaller, clean sans-serif text for descriptions and UI elements.

A predominantly monochrome palette of white and dark grey is subtly accented by soft, muted pastel backgrounds for distinct content blocks, providing visual segmentation without overwhelming the minimalist aesthetic.
No scroll-triggered motion; content scrolls naturally without reveals, animations, or sticky elements. The navigation bar remains static at the top of the viewport.
App feature cards consistently display a unique icon, app name, short description, and a 'Download on the App Store' link, arranged in a three-column grid with subtle background color variations.

technique_notes: Minimalist Layout: Achieved by using a single, centered content column with wide margins and significant vertical padding between sections, creating an airy and uncluttered feel.
Typographic Hierarchy: Established by pairing a large, elegant serif font for primary headings with a clean, legible sans-serif for all other text, ensuring clear visual distinction and readability.

Subtle Color Accents: Uses a predominantly monochrome palette (white background, dark text) and introduces soft, muted pastel colors only within specific content elements (like app cards) to provide visual segmentation without overwhelming the minimalist aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with small, legible sans-serif body text and even smaller sans-serif labels/links.
design_tokens.radius: subtle (slightly rounded corners on app cards and CTA button).
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, especially vertically between sections, creating a sense of calm and focus. Content within sections is balanced.

standout: The site's standout feature is its extreme minimalism and focus on typography. It uses a very sparse layout with vast amounts of whitespace and relies almost entirely on the elegant contrast between a large, distinctive serif heading font and a clean sans-serif body text to convey sophistication and clarity, rather than images or complex UI elements.
